6339.title: Docked sidebar reserves an unrelated edge inset
6339.rootCauseOneLine: The left-docked surface reserves right safe-area padding while its right-anchored list retains a width that excludes only the left rail.
6339.proposedFix: Remove right inset padding from the docked left sidebar; preserve compact drawer padding.
6339.caveats: Chromium with deterministic safe-area substitution; no physical iOS or WebKit run.
